lines.t: Did you hear about the intruder?
I heard, I heard! It was a boy, right?

Aww, I wasn't in the dorm, I wanted to
see!

it seems there was no damage this time,
though.

Maybe he just mistook it for the boys'
dorm?

Look, this place is needlessly big and
the rooms all have the same layout.

I once walked into the boys' dorm by
accident too,

and when I went into the restroom there
was a boy I didn't know. I totally
panicked!
You'd think they'd notice before that.
